عُطْلَةٌ The state of being, or remaining, without work, or occupation; (S, MA, O, K;) a subst. from تَعَطَّلَ. (S, O, K.) One says, هُوَ يَشْكُو العُطْلَةَ [He complains of being without work, or occupation]. (TA.) ―
-b2- And هُوَ ذُو عُطْلَةٍ means He is one who has no estate upon which to labour, or work. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
